name: Grok Usage
author: Chris Rueber
description: Grok plan allowance in the Omarchy bar: the official Grok mark with the current limit meter, plus a popup with the percentage, reset clock, plan tier, billing amounts, and local session activity. Reads the snapshot Grok already writes locally; no API key or network request.

barWidget.description: Bar pill with the Grok mark and the plan meter; click for percentage, reset time, tier, billing amounts, and local activity.

schema.label: Bar shows
schema.description: bars: the mark plus the limit meter; text: the percentage; icon: just the mark.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-read the local Grok snapshot. Five minutes is the default; reads are local and cheap, and a disk cache means shell restarts do not cause extra reads.

schema.label: Warning threshold (%)
schema.description: The meter turns the warning colour at this percentage.

schema.label: Critical threshold (%)
schema.description: The meter turns the urgent colour at this percentage.

schema.label: Warning colour
schema.description: Hex colour; empty keeps the theme foreground.

schema.label: Critical colour
schema.description: Hex colour; empty uses the theme's urgent colour.

schema.label: Node executable
schema.description: Optional. Path to node for the small log reader; empty finds node in your login shell PATH.

schema.label: Grok home
schema.description: Optional. Directory holding logs and sessions; empty uses $GROK_HOME or ~/.grok.

schema.label: Show local activity in the popup
schema.description: Adds sessions, turns, tokens, and Grok's recorded cost from local session ledgers for the current billing period.

schema.label: Right-click command
schema.description: Optional shell command; empty opens grok.com.
